root_cause: Commercial transactions are being downgraded due to missing Level 2/3 data for RuPay debit cards.
diagnosis: Because the merchant does not supply L2/L3 commercial card data, the acquirer treats the transactions as lower‑rate consumer sales, resulting in fees that are lower than the modeled commercial benchmark (illustrative source).
action_rationale: Providing accurate Level 2/3 data will ensure the correct commercial interchange rates are applied, eliminating the fee leakage.
